youtube_title: Your Bank Pays You 2.5%… Then Charges 10%+ 🏦 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: your bank pays about 2.5% on savings. What does it charge your friend on a loan?

₹1 lakh in savings earns about ₹2,500 a year. The same day, the bank lends money like it as a personal loan at 10-15%. That gap (the spread) is how banks earn. Your idle money is working, just not for you.

Rule: keep 3-6 months of expenses in savings for emergencies. Make a plan for the rest, once you understand it.
Moral: Idle money works too. Just not for you.

Source: SBI savings ~2.5%, personal loan 10-15% (SBI, 2026)
Education only, not investment advice.
